findings.sectionRef: Plan 06 — Files > To create + Verification A
findings.description: plans/ralph-pipeline-06-skills.md prescribes the unit-test path as `scripts/lib/__tests__/deriveNextCommand.test.mjs` (lines 36 and 170), but the shipped implementation places the tests flat under `scripts/lib/derive-next-command.test.mjs` and `scripts/lib/derive-next-command-cli.test.mjs`. The `scripts/lib/__tests__/` directory does not exist. Job CLAUDE.md explicitly mandates the flat layout: `Tests live flat under scripts/lib/<name>.test.mjs (no __tests__/ subdirectory).` Anyone re-reading the plan to find the tests would look in the wrong place.
findings.resolution: Updated lines 36 and 170 to flat-layout test paths.
findings.suggestedFix: Edit plans/ralph-pipeline-06-skills.md: (a) line 36 replace `scripts/lib/__tests__/deriveNextCommand.test.mjs OR add cases to tools/overview-viewer/src/__tests__/ralphStage.test.ts` with `scripts/lib/derive-next-command.test.mjs (one case per stage value, flat layout per repo convention) plus scripts/lib/derive-next-command-cli.test.mjs for the CLI wrapper`; (b) line 170 replace `pnpm test scripts/lib/__tests__/deriveNextCommand.test.mjs` with `pnpm test scripts/lib/derive-next-command.test.mjs`.

findings.sectionRef: Plan 06 — Read for reference + Version-pin note

The 5.30.0 cache directory does not exist on disk. Readers picking up Plan 06 later will look at the wrong skill source-of-truth.

findings.sectionRef: Plan 06 — Skill body step 5 + Common mistakes #3
findings.description: plans/ralph-pipeline-06-skills.md instructs the skill to shell out to Node via inline `node -e "import('./scripts/lib/derive-next-command.mjs').then(m => console.log(JSON.stringify(m.deriveNextCommand(...))))"` (lines 103 and 192). The shipped implementation instead introduced a dedicated CLI wrapper at `scripts/lib/derive-next-command-cli.mjs`, which `.claude/skills/work-on/SKILL.md` invokes as `node scripts/lib/derive-next-command-cli.mjs --task <id>`. The plan never mentions this CLI helper file even though it is now a Source-of-truth-adjacent module and ships with its own test file. Plan readers will be misled about how the skills integrate with the predicate, and the file list in `## Files > To create` is incomplete.
findings.resolution: Added CLI wrapper to Files+test+step 5+common mistake #3.
findings.suggestedFix: Edit plans/ralph-pipeline-06-skills.md: (a) under `## Files > To create`, add a bullet for `scripts/lib/derive-next-command-cli.mjs` describing it as the thin Node CLI wrapper around `deriveNextCommand` that resolves repoRoot via `git rev-parse --show-toplevel`, reads `plans/overview-snapshot.json`, and prints the resulting `NextCommand | null` as JSON on stdout (plus the matching test file `scripts/lib/derive-next-command-cli.test.mjs`); (b) rewrite the line-103 `Derive next command` step to invoke `node scripts/lib/derive-next-command-cli.mjs --task <selected-task-id>` and parse stdout as JSON, rather than the inline `node -e "import(...)"` form; (c) update Common mistake #3 (line 192) to describe the CLI wrapper as the integration shape used by skills, with the inline-import note kept only as historical rationale or dropped.

findings.description: plans/ralph-pipeline-INDEX.md's `Source-of-truth modules shared across plans` table lists only `scripts/lib/derive-next-command.mjs` (introduced in 06, consumed by 06 (skills), 09 (MCP)). The shipped Plan 06 implementation introduced a second module, `scripts/lib/derive-next-command-cli.mjs`, which is the actual integration shape every repo-local skill (`/work-on`, `/triage`, `/blocker-report`) consumes per `.claude/skills/work-on/SKILL.md` line 80 (`node scripts/lib/derive-next-command-cli.mjs --task <selected-task-id>`), `.claude/skills/blocker-report/SKILL.md` line 102, and `.claude/skills/triage/SKILL.md` line 90. The CLI wrapper is now a shared contract between three skills and the predicate ESM, but the INDEX claims `derive-next-command.mjs` is consumed directly by 06 (skills) — which is the historical inline-import shape that the implementation deliberately replaced (see F-003). Plan 06's final acceptance criterion (line 167) requires the implementing agent to refresh the INDEX's `Source-of-truth modules` table for new file paths and behavior contracts; that audit missed the new CLI wrapper. Downstream cascade: Plan 12's extraction file list (plans/ralph-pipeline-12-package-as-plugin.md line 102) also omits `scripts/lib/derive-next-command-cli.mjs` from the files-to-remove inventory, so a future Plan 12 implementer would leave the CLI wrapper behind in codexu after plugin extraction and break all three skills.
findings.suggestedFix: Edit plans/ralph-pipeline-INDEX.md: under `## Source-of-truth modules shared across plans`, add a new row immediately after the existing `scripts/lib/derive-next-command.mjs` row (currently line 199) for the CLI wrapper: | `scripts/lib/derive-next-command-cli.mjs` | 06 | Thin Node CLI around `deriveNextCommand`: resolves `repoRoot` via `git rev-parse --show-toplevel`, reads `plans/overview-snapshot.json` (override with `--snapshot <file>`), looks up `--task <id>` case-insensitively against `snapshot.tasks[].id`, and writes the resulting `NextCommand | null` as one JSON line to stdout. Errors go to stderr with non-zero exit. | 06 (`/work-on`, `/triage`, `/blocker-report`) |. Also update the existing `scripts/lib/derive-next-command.mjs` row's `Consumed by` column from `06 (skills), 09 (MCP)` to `06 (CLI wrapper + future UI), 09 (MCP)` so the table reflects that skills now go through the CLI rather than importing the .mjs directly. Then edit plans/ralph-pipeline-12-package-as-plugin.md line 102 to include `scripts/lib/derive-next-command-cli.mjs` in the comma-separated extraction list right after `scripts/lib/derive-next-command.mjs` (and add its matching `.d.mts` file to the catch-all at the end of that bullet).
